issues.detail: Hebrew 'וְכָל שֶׁבֶר' means 'and all grain/produce' (from שֶׁבֶר, grain), but Chinese renders it as '一切毀壞之物' ('all destroyed things'), which changes the meaning.

Chinese adds '債務' ('debts') after '第七年' ('seventh year'), but the Hebrew 'וְנִטֹּשׁ אֶת הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית וּמַשָּׁא כָל יָד' means 'and we will abandon the seventh year and every hand's loan/debt' — the word 'debt' is not in the Hebrew, though 'מַשָּׁא' means 'loan/debt' and is rendered as '重利' ('heavy interest'), which is a mistranslation; 'מַשָּׁא' means 'debt/loan', not 'interest'.
